test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fixed_string_bit_const (value16 FixedString(16), value3 FixedString(3), value6 FixedString(6), value15 FixedString(15), value17 FixedString(17), value31 FixedString(31), value64 FixedString(64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fixed_string_bit_const WITH repeat(concat(toString(number), unhex('00F17E')), 16) AS source SELECT toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 16), 16), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 3), 3), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 6), 6), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 15), 15), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 17), 17), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 31), 31), toFixedString(substring(source, 1, 64), 64) FROM numbers(1048576)
test.query: SELECT bitAnd(value{width}, toFixedString(substring(repeat(unhex('A501F0803C12D769'), 8), 1, {width}), {width})) FROM fixed_string_bit_const FORMAT Null
SELECT bitOr(value{width}, toFixedString(substring(repeat(unhex('A501F0803C12D769'), 8), 1, {width}), {width})) FROM fixed_string_bit_const FORMAT Null
SELECT bitXor(value{width}, toFixedString(substring(repeat(unhex('A501F0803C12D769'), 8), 1, {width}), {width})) FROM fixed_string_bit_const FORMAT Null
